# viettelidc_ovpc_security_group_attachment (Resource)

Provides a resource to attach a Security Group to an OVPC instance.

~> **WARNING:** Do not use this resource if you are already managing `security_group_ids` inside the `viettelidc_ovpc_instance` resource, as they will conflict and cause Terraform state drift.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The ID of the instance to attach the security group to.
- `security_group_id` (String) The ID of the security group to attach.

### Optional

- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
